title: Try the Handpan! Onsen meets Handpan! — October 31
body:
A special experience where hot springs meet the handpan.

Enjoy the mystical tones of the handpan at Hachi Beppu The Sky in Kannawa Onsen. Beginners are welcome, and premium handpans are available to borrow free of charge.

📅 Date & time: Saturday, October 31, 2026, 14:00–17:00
📍 Venue: Hachi Beppu The Sky
👥 Capacity: 4 people per session
🎫 Fee: ¥3,500
🎶 Handpan experience (instrument rental included)

For advance reservations, contact @hachibeppu on Instagram.

title: 🍁 Sound & Stillness — Autumn Equinox Handpan Gathering (completed)
body:
A special music event held on the autumn equinox at Eifukuji Temple in Kannawa Onsen, Beppu, surrounded by the sounds of handpans.

Performers included RRyusuque, who performs and leads workshops around the world; Shun Yokoyama, who moved from Yamagata to Oita to pursue music; and SoLua (Shin & Nari). Guests enjoyed the beautiful resonance of Yishama handpans up close.

The program also included a free handpan experience and herbal tea by Aya Sato, representative of herbioFarm.

📅 Date: Wednesday, September 23, 2026 (public holiday)
🕓 Time: 16:00–18:30
　Free experience: 16:00–16:30
　Live performance: 16:30–18:00
📍 Venue: Eifukuji Temple | Kannawa Onsen, Beppu
🎫 Admission: ¥2,500
🎶 Handpan live performance and free experience
🌿 Herbal tea by herbioFarm
🌏 English welcome

Performers and related accounts:
RRyusuque @rryusuque
Shun Yokoyama @greenwater014
SoLua @shin0326.solfeggio
Solfeggio Resonance Lab @solfeggio_resonance_lab
Hachi Beppu @hachibeppu
selected_handpan @selected_handpan
herbioFarm / Aya Sato @_sato_aya_

The event was held as a chance to enjoy music and stillness in Beppu, the hot spring city, at the start of autumn.

title: Handpan Open Day with Reo Matsumoto — May 31 (Sun), 17:00–19:00 — Pop-up event!
body:
A chance for everyone, from those curious about handpans to seasoned players!

Top handpan player Reo Matsumoto is holding a Handpan Open Day in Kannawa Onsen.

Enjoy Reo's handpan music against the backdrop of rising hot-spring steam, or join in whether you're just wondering what a handpan is or already love playing one. Everyone can enjoy two hours together.

The detailed program is not fixed; activities may change depending on the weather and attendance.

📍 Venue: Hachi Beppu The Sky
Please note there are stairs. Children may attend only when their family can ensure their safety.

💰 Donations welcome
🍱 Please bring your own food and drinks

🅿️ Please use the Kannawa Onsen district parking area.
